name: memory_occluded_kept
about: Seen, then hidden behind the block: the enemy goes occluded and stays committed. CAI_BaseNPC::GatherEnemyConditions 0x10270b20 (conditions-and-states.md, slot 481): every gather FVisible slot 201 misses the enemy and m_eEnemyOccludedCheck +0x5b98 counts up, saturating at 10; at 10 it sets ENEMY_OCCLUDED 0x48 and, with m_afMemory 0x20000 standing, fires m_OnLostPlayerLOS (player enemy) then m_OnLostEnemyLOS. Later in the same GatherConditions 0x1026ec30 (1026efa4, after slot 481 at 1026ee5b) the Troika half 0x1028e790 runs the occlusion debounce 0x1028e700(0x48, &m_flOccludedReportTimeE +0x62cc): the first pass with 0x48 standing arms the stamp at curtime + m_flOccludedDelay (+0x62c8, = m_flOccludedDelayNormal without a hint node, NPCThink 0x1029316b; rules.txt Npc_Combat_Info OccludedDelayNormal 0.50) and CLEARS 0x48 while curtime < stamp, so the outputs fire at the tenth miss and the condition is first reported 0.5 s later (re-stated 2026-10-04, Q-H2). Nothing forgets him: CAI_Memory has no time-based expiry (senses.md 'The enemy memory -- CAI_Memory', RefreshMemories 0x102df320), and LOST_ENEMY 0x47 has one setter, ChooseEnemy 0x10279dd0, only when BestEnemy answers null after the enemy was marked eluded (MarkAsEluded 0x102dfd90). GatherEnemyConditions' eluded tail runs only once curtime - LastTimeSeen > 8.0 (_DAT_1045597c); on a Troika NPC it then needs DONE_EXTRAPOLATING (m_bfAINPCFlags 0x8000) or ENEMY_UNREACHABLE 0x59 with a blocked ray to the last known position; TASK_SET_ENEMY_ELUDED appears only in the Tzimisce and Hengeyokai chase programs. So no LOST_ENEMY can appear within 8 s of the last sighting, and the committed enemy keeps the NPC in COMBAT (GetSchedule 0x102ae920 step 5: GetEnemy() == NULL is the only way back to ALERT/IDLE). Guard on behind_cover (156, 0) Source units facing -X, D_HT 5, npc_perception 3, no weapon; the player in view at (40, 250) from t = 0, teleported behind the block to (-176, -60) at t = 1.0 (both the guard's spot and the last-known position (40, 250) see that spot only through the block).
